notes: PCI Express 5.0 mandates Lane Margining at the Receiver — a protocol-level, in-system eye-margin probe that runs in L0 without interrupting traffic. External compliance testing follows the PCI-SIG Compliance Program. PHY transceivers implement closed-loop adaptive CTLE/DFE + CDR + impedance trim per-implementation.

calibration_categories.name: Eye diagram (HS pair)
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify HS driver/receiver/channel quality at the target data rate; measure jitter, eye height, eye width, common-mode.

calibration_categories.name: HS swing trim
calibration_categories.purpose: Adjust HS driver current to land in 100-200 mV differential swing across PVT.

calibration_categories.name: Lane delay-line trim
calibration_categories.purpose: Per-lane programmable delay to bring inter-pair skew ≤ 100 ps; usually trained on Sync.

calibration_categories.name: T-HS-EXIT measurement
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify LP-11 dwell ≥ 100 ns after every HS Exit.

calibration_categories.name: LP rise / fall time
calibration_categories.purpose: Confirm LP swing meets 1.2 V CMOS thresholds at target data rate (≤ 10 Mbps).

calibration_categories.name: Sync-pattern detection threshold
calibration_categories.purpose: Sweep input voltage / noise to verify receiver locks on 8'b00011101 at minimum margin.

calibration_categories.name: Clock-Lane PLL lock
calibration_categories.purpose: Confirm source PLL hits target DDR frequency = data-rate / 2 within ppm tolerance.

calibration_categories.name: ECC self-check
calibration_categories.purpose: Inject 1-bit / 2-bit errors into header; confirm correction + detection.

calibration_categories.name: CRC self-check
calibration_categories.purpose: Inject CRC-16 mismatch into payload; confirm receiver reports error.

calibration_categories.name: Vendor sideband I2C config
calibration_categories.purpose: Apply per-sensor register config (gain / exposure / ROI / VC / DT / lane count) over I2C before enabling HS payload.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: 32 GT/s eye diagram per Lane
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify TX output + RX input meet the Gen5 32 GT/s NRZ eye masks after equalization.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Lane Margining at the Receiver
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: In-system eye-margin probe in L0 (time left/right + optional voltage up/down), error-rate reporting. Mandatory at Gen5.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Equalization convergence
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the four-phase enhanced EQ opens the eye at 32 GT/s with the requested presets and any retimers.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Precoding effectiveness
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: With precoding on, verify reduced DFE burst-error propagation at 32 GT/s.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Jitter budget at 32 GT/s
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Keep post-CDR BER below the Gen5 target (31.25 ps UI).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Retimer insertion test
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify train + equalize with 1 or 2 retimers, each adding latency.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Protocol analyzer (TLP/DLLP) at 32 GT/s
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Decode 128b/130b block streams into packet classes.
